purpose: Refinement study for the user-requested hybrid of original ABI card and o11 typography/materials
notes: Approved side-by-side desktop layout; mobile stacks. Generated mark is illustrative; implementation retains the actual ABI wordmark and original VaultBankCard. No card network or spendable credit claim.
approvalEvidence: User selected Checklist beside card, as in the study; also confirmed opaque content and glass navigation/card.
prompt: Create a high-fidelity desktop web application UI design study for ABI, 1536 by 1024 landscape. This is a precise product UI, not a poster. Match the restrained o11 wallet app visual system: Inter typeface, regular 400 body and control lettering, medium 500 headings, #fafafa canvas, #262626 text, #525252 secondary, opaque very pale gray #f4f4f4 content rows, medium gray #e5e5e5 input fields, restrained cornflower-blue primary buttons, thin soft white highlights. The user wants an evolution of their original ABI console: use an original ABI charcoal/silver bank-card visual as the distinctive central feature. Header at top with ABI wordmark left, quiet links Overview, Marketplace, Connect, Billing, Settings; right workspace avatar button. Main content centered max1100. Upper title Overview. A compact three-row Get started checklist at left, each row light gray with subtle rounded corners, labels Connect your agent / Find your first product / Set a spending limit, action buttons Connect / Browse / Add limit. At right a tasteful deep charcoal ABI Vault bank-card face with official-looking geometric ABI mark, a decorative masked identifier rather than card credentials, General workspace, USDC and Base Sepolia; a sophisticated silver edge and restrained glass sheen, not a payment card for card networks. Above this card small workspace row General and 0.00 USDC available; clearly label illustrative state Design preview. Below a low understated row Agent allowances with No allowances yet and Create allowance control. Bottom a floating frosted-glass dock with five consistent outline icons and tiny labels Overview, Marketplace, Connect, Billing, Settings, selected neutral inset tile. Glass only on this navigation, menus and ABI card, never translucent content cards. No leather illustration, no third-party provider logos, no charts, no technical pages such as ledgers or webhooks, no Demo/Live switch, no free credit claim. Clear whitespace, aligned controls, soft radius 12 on rows and 16 on dock, realistic web UI scale. Keep original ABI identity while reproducing o11 typography, neutral material, layering and blue actions.
